name: skk-userscript
description: Local SKK Japanese input for Firefox and Chrome userscript managers

scripts.check: vp check && vp test run && vp build && vp run test:browser && vp run test:editors
scripts.typecheck:editors: node scripts/editor-install.mjs && vp lint --config test/editors/oxlint.json --tsconfig test/editors/tsconfig.json test/editors/*/fixture.ts test/editors/codemirror5.d.ts
